content: Hello, thank you for connecting with Amazon Resolution Center. My name is Michael. How are you doing today?
Hi, um, I'm okay, thanks. I just got a message about an order issue?
Yes, I see that there is a hold on your recent Amazon order due to a verification step. I want to help you resolve this as smoothly as possible.
Oh, okay. Is there a problem with my account?

There is nothing wrong on your end, but due to new customs regulations, Amazon must verify some details before we can deliver or refund your order. May I confirm your full name and address linked to your account?
Um, yeah, it's Riley Chen. The address is 418 Maple Street, Apt 10, Lakewood.
Thank you, Riley. For your security, could you provide the phone number connected with your Amazon account?

Perfect. Now, according to our policy update, there is a temporary customs compliance fee of $149 required for international shipments and high-value orders. This is a government-mandated process, but you will be reimbursed in full once the order clears.
Wait, I have to pay again? I already paid for my order.

I completely understand your concern. This is a new policy affecting many customers. The fee is separate from your order total and will be refunded by Amazon after processing. If we don't receive it, unfortunately, your order and account may be suspended due to government non-compliance.
I really don't want my account to be suspended... How do I pay this fee?
To ensure quick processing, we use Amazon-approved digital payment methods. You can purchase an Amazon Gift Card or use Zelle for instant verification. Which would you prefer?
Um, I guess I can get a gift card? I've never used Zelle before.
No problem at all. Once you have the gift card, simply read the code to me. This is a secure process monitored by Amazon. I will stay on the line and guide you each step.
Okay, should I get it online or go to the store?
Either method works. For your convenience, you can buy it through Amazon's website and email, or at stores like Walmart or Walgreens. Please let me know when you have the code ready.
Alright, I can try to buy one online now. Is there a certain amount I need to get?
Yes, please purchase one for $149 to match the compliance fee. I'll need the full 16-digit code to process your order.
Okay, I'm doing that now.
Thank you, Riley. Please remember, once I confirm your payment, your order will be released within 24 hours and your refund will be processed automatically.
Do I need to do anything else after I give you the code?
No further action is needed from your side. If you do not complete this today, unfortunately, your order may be permanently canceled and your Amazon privileges may be limited.
Oh, I don't want that to happen. I'll get the code and call you right back if I have trouble.
I recommend staying on the line for immediate assistance. This ensures your account remains in good standing and avoids unnecessary delays.
